analysis_type: Post-hoc comparison of three internal and six external same-point bound decompositions; no refitting or new experiment

comparison_rule.available_points: 369 internal plus 527 external equals 896 descriptive available points, not a universal sample or probability estimate
comparison_rule.scope_separation: Retain two internal rooted unavailable folds separately from 234 external unavailable points; do not create a combined success rate
comparison_rule.classification: Reuse the already frozen 0.5 dominance classifications without retuning
comparison_rule.validation: Require zero source identity mismatches and zero undefined zero bounds in both inputs
comparison_rule.datasets: Preserve Hahn1, Thurber, Kirby2, Filip, MGH17, Gauss1, Misra1a, Chwirut1 and ENSO as separate distributions
comparison_rule.related_dataset_scope: Chwirut1 was not used in previous region design, but shares its study and native model family with Chwirut2; it is not an independent model-family or laboratory replication test
comparison_rule.periodic_candidate_scope: The ENSO candidate is not the native ENSO nine-parameter Fourier model; its 131 tighter ellipsoid/box pairs are a subset and not a probability or whole-dataset claim

prohibitions: No universal internal-versus-external ranking or combined success rate
No erasure of internal rooted folds, external unavailable points, Chwirut1/Chwirut2 relatedness or ENSO candidate scope
No probability, variance-decomposition or physical-mechanism interpretation of arithmetic shares
